fee_notes: First ZIPS Cleaners Business: $40,000. Each subsequent ZIPS Cleaners Business: $20,000. Under a Development Agreement, first unit is $40,000 and each subsequent unit is $20,000. The highest and lowest initial franchise fees actually paid during the last complete fiscal year was $15,000. Qualified veterans receive a 20% reduction per franchised business opened via the IFA VetFran Program. A separate Conversion Fee of $10,000 applies for converting an existing business. A Development Fee of $10,000 per unit is required under a Development Agreement and is credited against the Initial Franchise Fee. All fees are non-refundable and fully earned when paid.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee for your first ZIPS Cleaners Business is $40,000.  The Initial Franchise Fee for each subsequent ZIPS Cleaners business you develop is $20,000. If you sign a Development Agreement, the Initial Franchise Fee for the first ZIPS Cleaners Business that you develop under the Development Agreement will be $40,000 and $20,000 for each subsequent ZIPS Cleaners Business.  The Initial Franchise Fee must be paid to ZIPS no later than the date you sign the Franchise Agreement. ... The highest and lowest initial franchise fees actually paid to us during our last complete fiscal year was $15,000.
